verification_note: Withdrawn 2026-10-23 (session-6327cf90). This event is the OLBG fixture 'Abel-Moda Brusque W vs Praia Clube W', but the verification record transcribed from the Brazilian federation's Superliga Feminina listing carried the venue 'Sportville, Barueri' and the local kick-off '2026-10-25 18:30 BRT' belonging to a DIFFERENT fixture — the record's own facts field names 'Paulistano Barueri vs Gerdau Minas', not this match. Both the venue and the clock are therefore blanked and the status downgraded to unverified rather than corrected, because re-reading the federation listing to find the right line for this fixture was not possible in this pass and the correct values must not be inferred from the neighbouring rows. The fixture identity itself (teams and competition) comes from the OLBG listing and is unaffected. The two prediction pieces that inherited these venues — 'home-court familiarity in Bauru' for Mackenzie and 'home-court energy' at Barueri for Brusque — have been rewritten. See FL-158; the same defect class was repaired on the SuperLega rows 36994/36997 by FL-154.
